en-US.name: VIP Monthly
en-US.description: Every pack and every past month, no breaks

reviewNote: Auto-renewable monthly subscription with a 7-day free trial. VIP unlocks every pack (including past monthly daily packs) and hides the game's own store promotions. The grant is applied server-side by our Appwrite Function after verifying the signed transaction; the function runs in Production and falls back to Sandbox for sandbox transactions, so App Review's Sandbox purchases verify. Test: Home > tap coin balance > Store > Go VIP > Monthly, confirm with a Sandbox Apple ID. A VIP badge appears on Home and in Profile within a few seconds.

winBackOffers.note: Default chosen 2026-10-14 (owner can change): the first month back for $0.99 instead of $2.99, for people who paid for at least a month and lapsed 1 to 12 months ago; once a year at most.
